note: Set A's wiring-schedule claims (symbols 31–34, 50, 150, 151) are read correctly and bound to the right symbol rows, and its revision-table entries are accurate. Set B covers the NOTES block more broadly but repeatedly garbles it (150A/SNAP main breaker instead of 50A/2P, 'MIDS' for NFDS, 'HEMPEL'/'HEMLOCK' for NEMA 3R), invents 60 Hz and 100 A values that appear nowhere on the page, misbinds symbol 34 as a DC disconnect, and repeats the main-service-panel connection and 120/240 V facts several times. A's errors are limited to one invented connection (2 to 20) and one misread 'quantity 50', plus a few trivial label claims.
remarks: Both sets largely miss the NOTES equipment specs: 2.8kW inverter with ground fault, 60A DC NFDS (Note 5), 200A/2P NFDS (B has the rating, A omits it), and the 50A/2P main breaker on the PV sub-panel. The text layer flattens the note numbering (notes run 2, 4, 5, 6, 7), which likely caused B's wrong note references; B also shows OCR-style corruption ('UND FAULT', 'HEMPEL', 'HEMLOCK', 'MIDS') suggesting it worked from a degraded text layer. A's quotes '2 ... 20' and '4 -> 31' are paraphrases rather than literal page text.
